name: tds-invoice-total
title: TDS Invoice Total
description: Invoice calculator for Indian freelancers: fee + GST − TDS = what reaches the bank, using the rate and section for the invoice date (s.393 of the 2025 Act; was 194J/194C) and yearly thresholds, flagging TDS on GST, the wrong rate and the no-PAN rate, with a note for the client.

meta.stops: Freelancer short-paid after TDS on GST
meta.summary: Works out what an Indian freelancer's invoice actually lands as after GST and TDS, and flags TDS taken on GST or at the wrong rate.
catches: TDS deducted on the GST portion
Wrong rate for the kind of work (professional 10%, technical 2%, contract 1%/2%)
Thresholds (₹50,000 a year for professional/technical; ₹30,000 a sum or ₹1 lakh a year for contracts) and catch-up on crossing
Payers who don't deduct (person paying for personal use, client abroad)
Higher rate when no PAN is shared
limits: Invoice date is used as a proxy; the Act that applies depends on the earlier of credit or payment
Does not handle lower-deduction certificates, non-resident payees or GST reverse charge
a11y: Every field has a <label>; aria-invalid and descriptions via aria-describedby
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix or the fee field
Copy-note button shows a copied state

rules.note: Confirmed in s.393(1) Table Sl. 6: contracts 1% (individual/HUF) or 2%, thresholds ₹30,000 per sum / ₹1,00,000 aggregate; professional fees 10%, technical services 2%, threshold ₹50,000; s.393(4) Sl. 8–9 personal-purpose exemption. Not re-checked: the 20% no-PAN rate (s.397) and the GST exclusion (CBDT Circular 23/2017). Informational; verify with the official source or a professional.
